limitations: Only the Draw row has a wired before/after sorting navigation example; other pin components toggle visual states, not arbitrary task-array sorting.
No prototype-player click acceptance, multi-pin pagination simulation, focus restoration, persistence or native acceptance is claimed.
Comparison board covers changed controls in six language/theme combinations, not six complete app flows.
Existing screen shells and unrelated historical details are retained; exact changed-control dimensions do not imply whole-screen pixel parity.
Existing paper silhouettes and curls are editable approximations; only environment and paper textures use image fills.
